evidence.title: Free ASCII Art Generator, Image & Video to ASCII | ASCII Magic

name: ASCII Magic
summary: Browser-based ASCII art generator that turns photos and videos into ASCII, pixel, voxel and 100+ other styles.
description: A free, no-signup studio for turning images and videos into ASCII art and other effects entirely in the browser: 100+ art styles, 20 one-click recipes, post-processing (glitch, bloom, CRT, scanlines, halftone, vignette) and 171 AI generative presets. An MCP server lets agents run the same render pipeline, with export up to 4K resolution.
contains: 100+ art styles: ASCII, pixel, voxel, mosaic, halftone, glitch, LEGO, oil paint
171 AI generative presets steered by prompt, strength and resolution
Post-processing effects: glitch, bloom, CRT curvature, scanlines, halftone, vignette, film grain
MCP server for agents: ASCII text or rendered image per tool call, export up to 4K
Free, no signup, renders in the browser
